messages:
maria: Quick kickoff 1-line copy bundle needed for hosted / dedicated / private pages + social + webinar. Must include hero variants, 1-line benchmark for social, 3 CTAs (mode-specific), and distinct demo URLs for inbound routing. Deliver drafts by Wed EOD.
lucas: I'll draft hero headlines and 2 proof bullets per mode (latency, cost, SLA). Tone: engineer-forward, but friendly.
anya: I'll do the webinar landing + two subject lines and the social post copy. Suggest workshop format with hands-on examples.
elaine: Reminder: Dedicated = "reserved GPU pools" + SLA language. Private = KMS/HSM + on-prem availability. Security will review private wording Wed AM.
nora: I'll provision demo endpoints: /demo-hosted, /demo-dedicated, /demo-private and wire Sales queues: trials vs enterprise. Need final CTA slugs and UTMs.
ops-bot: placeholder event created for 2026-06-02 10:00 PT. Reminders 7d/1d prior.
maria: Nice. Need 3 CTA variants short and A/B ready. Also need a tweet-sized benchmark line that marketing can publish.
lucas: CTAs:
- Hosted: "Start hosted trial" / "Try hosted API" / "Launch a hosted trial"
- Dedicated: "Reserve dedicated capacity" / "Book capacity" / "Get SLA-backed throughput"
- Private: "Request private deployment" / "Schedule on-prem demo" / "Talk to sales"
Benchmark line (tweet): "95th-pct latency <120ms  3x token cost savings vs baseline (internal tests)"
anya: Webinar subject A: "Cut LLM inference costs without sacrificing latency" B: "Practical patterns for production inference". Landing hero: "Workshop: run LLMs at predictable latency and lower cost." Social teaser sample: "Live workshop 6/2: how teams reduce inference cost while keeping latency tight. Register -> {shortlink}?utm_campaign=tri-launch"
elaine: Engineering will confirm benchmark numbers Tue EOD. Security to review private copy Wed 12:00. If wording needs to change, ping asap.
maria: Great progress. Final deliverables: hero (two variants per page), single-line benchmark, 3 CTAs per mode, webinar page copy, and routing URLs. Review meeting Thu 9am PT. Thanks all :tada:
